advice.На открытом или синтетическом наборе дан: Use an open or synthetic dataset to write queries with a JOIN, grouping and a window function. Save the queries and explain how you checked the results.
advice.Создайте небольшой скрипт обработки синт: Build a small script to process synthetic data: input validation, transformation, reporting and tests. Save the code and instructions.
advice.На синтетических данных подготовьте табл: Use synthetic data to create a spreadsheet with formulas, a summary report and error checks. Explain which decision the report supports.
advice.Если доступен учебный стенд Битрикс24, н: If a Bitrix24 training environment is available, configure a demo pipeline and describe its stages and transition rules. Do not use real customer data.
advice.В учебной CRM опишите демонстрационную в: In a training CRM, describe a demo pipeline, record fields and data-quality rules. Name the system you used.
advice.Подготовьте учебный кейс корпоративной п: Prepare a practice B2B sales case: company profile, discovery questions and a proposal. Separate the exercise from real deals.
advice.Разберите реальную или учебную командную: Review a real or practice team task: roles, plan, risks and feedback. State explicitly whether you managed people.
advice.Подготовьте краткий рассказ о своем прое: Prepare a short account of your project in English and record answers about your role. Self-assessment does not establish a CEFR level.
advice.Выберите подтвержденный пример и подгото: Choose a confirmed example and prepare an account of the task, your role, actions and known result. Do not add missing numbers.
advice.Сначала проверьте, есть ли такой опыт. Е: First check whether you have this experience. If so, add a precise clarification to your profile and confirm it separately.
advice.Если опыта нет, сформулируйте небольшой: If you lack the experience, define a small practice project for this requirement with a checkable result. Label it as practice.
advice.Пометьте учебный проект как учебный. Сох: Label the project as practice. Keep an artifact: code, report, project description or feedback. Do not add the skill to your resume before completing the work and checking its result.
advice.Какую задачу вы решали, какую часть выпо: What task did you solve, which part did you do personally, and what supports the result?
advice.Есть ли у вас реальный пример по этому т: Do you have a real example for this requirement? If not, how can you explain your current level and learning plan honestly?
advice.Какие ограничения и ошибки возникли? Как: What limitations and errors arose? How did you check your work?
